query: moderate io latency retransmits queue growth after rollout
document: A checkout rollout increased retry fanout. No single signal crossed a hard failure threshold, but rising io latency, retransmits, and queue growth together predicted a later latency incident. Confirm rollout timing, inspect retry rate, and review connection pool saturation before scaling blindly.

query: memory growth reclaim pressure retry amplification
document: Sustained memory growth with reclaim pressure and mild timeout bursts was traced to retry amplification holding request state longer than expected. The safe first checks were cat /proc/pressure/memory and kubectl top pod before any restart.

query: softnet drops retransmit increase service latency
document: A packet processing backlog on one node caused softnet drops and retransmits before user-visible latency became severe. The team confirmed the interface with ip -s link and ss -s before moving traffic.
